summary: Moolec Science SA filed a Form 6-K to announce it regained compliance with all previously cited Nasdaq continued listing requirements, including periodic financial reporting (Rule 5250(c)(1)), minimum bid price (Rule 5550(a)(2)), and minimum stockholders' equity (Rule 5550(b)(1)), following a Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision dated January 23, 2026. The Panel imposed a discretionary monitoring period and a mandatory panel monitor for one year. No transaction, offer, or special-situation event occurred; this is a routine compliance update with no deal terms, advisor involvement, or strategic action.
